Name: Big Buck Hunter Pro
Description: Big Buck Hunter Pro is an arcade-style hunting game. Based on a new platform, it features a two-player simultaneous "Shootout" mode with improved graphics.

Achievements.Name: License to Kill
Achievements.Description: Kill 50 critters throughout your adventures.

Achievements.Name: Nice Rack
Achievements.Description: Kill your first buck or bull in any game mode.

Achievements.Name: Bullseye
Achievements.Description: Take down a buck or bull with a single head or heart shot.

Achievements.Name: 3 Up 3 Down
Achievements.Description: Kill all 3 bucks or bulls in a site.

Achievements.Name: Hunter Hero
Achievements.Description: Get the highest score for a single site.

Achievements.Name: Eatin Venison Tonight
Achievements.Description: Complete the full Whitetail Adventure.

Achievements.Name: King of the Hill
Achievements.Description: Complete the full Elk Adventure.

Achievements.Name: Feed the Whole Family
Achievements.Description: Kill a total of 25 bucks and bulls across your adventures.

Achievements.Name: Need a Bigger Truck
Achievements.Description: Kill a total of 50 bucks and bulls across your adventures.

Achievements.Name: Feed the Whole State
Achievements.Description: Kill a total of 100 bucks and bulls across your adventures.

Achievements.Name: Big Rack Connoisseur
Achievements.Description: Kill a total of 500 bucks and bulls across your adventures.

Achievements.Name: The Marksman
Achievements.Description: Take down all 3 bucks or bulls, each with a single shot, and have 100% accuracy for the round.

Achievements.Name: Pass it Around
Achievements.Description: Complete a single trek in 4-player multiplayer mode.

Achievements.Name: Cleaned Em Out
Achievements.Description: Kill all 45 bucks or bulls within a single adventure.

Achievements.Name: Foul Play

Achievements.Name: Au Revoir Gopher

Achievements.Name: Fully Croaked
Achievements.Description: Got a Double Perfect on Frog Flippin'.

Achievements.Name: Lonesome Hunter

Achievements.Name: Air Pie Marksman
Achievements.Description: Shoot all pies and get 100% accuracy in the Pie in the Sky Bonus Game.
